title: Army base shows during the war
summary: He played army bases for three months, flying from base to base, one night for officers and one for rookies.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: That's the governor there. Did you ever travel around with any political?
Political? I don't know what you'd say, you know.

Well during the war, political or, well, I would say this is military, I think. I played army bases three months. And we used to fly from base to base. We always stayed in one base two nights. First night for the officer we played and the next night was for the rookies. Next day we were flying out again. Well, I think of it, how far did these shows get, say like the Rabbit Foot, and how far north and east and west and all?
